expectations.text: AR_COUNT_EXACT: The number of statements in ar_list.md equals the total number of spec elements (1 Mission + each Goal + each Premise + each Constraint). If ar_list.md has more items than spec elements, the inversion drifted into extra smart-critique concerns.
expectations.evidence: v4 ar_list.md has 12 ARs; v4 spec has 15-19 elements (M+5G+4P+5H+4S per v4 inline spec pattern). No 1:1 matching — AR count does not equal spec element count.

expectations.text: AR_FORM_INVERSION: Each AR in ar_list.md is a flat present-tense 'not met' assertion. No hedging language, no reasoning about the artifact, no references to specific runtime behavior of the code.
expectations.evidence: v4 ar_list.md items are smart reasoned failure patterns with explanations: 'Exclusive-end range arithmetic (range(a, b) or b−a without +1) — treating 1-5 as Python's half-open range(1,5) yields [1,2,3,4]. → off-by-one truncation; the final item the user explicitly named is silently dropped.' These are analyzed, specific, artifact-inspecting patterns, not blind inversions.

expectations.text: AR_VERBATIM_IN_PROMPT: The numbered concerns/findings list in every reviewer prompt matches ar_list.md verbatim or near-verbatim — MASTER did not recompose them.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer prompts have a 'CONCERNS:' section with reality-grounded concerns that MASTER recomposed from the ARs after inspecting the actual code (e.g. 'parse_range("1-5") returns [1,2,3,4], not [1,2,3,4,5]. The demo in the __main__ block prints this wrong answer...'). These are not the ar_list.md text verbatim.

expectations.text: AR_INFERRER_CONTEXT_STARVED: ar_inferrer_prompt.txt contains only the MGPC spec — no artifact code, no user request, no examples drawn from running or reading the code.
expectations.evidence: v4 ar_inferrer_prompt.txt uses the v4 template: 'For each requirement, consider: What concrete failure mode... What implementation anti-pattern... What known industry/domain pitfall... What edge case or adversarial input?' This invites deep reasoning, not mechanical inversion.

expectations.text: TRUSTED_ASSESSOR_PT: Every reviewer prompt attributes the AR findings to a trusted senior authority presented as authoritative.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer prompts: 'I don't trust this code. It needs rigorous verification.' No trusted assessor attribution for the findings.

expectations.text: NON_TRUSTED_AI_AUTHOR_PT: Every reviewer prompt attributes the code to a non-capable AI (copilot autocomplete, AI-generated code, etc.) — NOT to a human. v4 had a bug where 'skip PT on code' caused inconsistency; v5 should always use non-capable-AI attribution for code.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer prompts use code-appropriate non-capable-AI attribution (copilot-style autocomplete).

expectations.text: NO_OUTCOME_IN_PROMPT: No reviewer prompt contains any outcome directive. The only directive is to do a deep-research pass.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer prompts include outcome directive: 'These concerns need rigorous investigation... verify each one... I'm relying on your investigation.' Explicit 'verify each' goal present.

expectations.text: NO_HEDGE_IN_PROMPT: No reviewer prompt hedges on the ARs. They are presented as the trusted assessor's authoritative findings.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer prompts: 'Don't assume the source got anything right. Don't assume the concerns are right either. Investigate.' Symmetric-distrust hedge present.

expectations.text: MASTER_VERIFIES_BOTH: The trace records MASTER verifying the reaction in both directions against the private spec.
expectations.evidence: trace.md exists; v4 runner confirmed DEFENSE at round 2 with MASTER verifying refutations.

expectations.text: REVIEWER_READ_ONLY: Reviewer returned text only; MASTER applied all edits; the source parse_range.py at inputs/ is unmodified.
expectations.evidence: 'Do not edit, create, or overwrite any files; return your analysis as text only.' in reviewer prompts.

expectations.text: SPEC_ESTABLISHED: An MGPC spec was built before the AR-inferrer was dispatched.
expectations.evidence: spec.md established with Mission + Goals + Premises + Constraints before attack.

expectations.text: NO_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT: No reviewer prompt assigns a role to the reviewer.
expectations.evidence: No role assignment in reviewer prompts.

expectations.text: NO_META_JARGON: No reviewer prompt leaks meta-architecture terms.
expectations.evidence: No meta-architecture jargon in reviewer prompts.

expectations.text: NO_SPEC_LEAK: No reviewer prompt contains spec labels or IDs.
expectations.evidence: No spec labels/IDs in reviewer prompts (concerns are direct assertions).

expectations.text: OUTPUT_HYGIENE: The final code contains no skill jargon.
expectations.evidence: Final parse_range.py contains no skill jargon.

expectations.text: ARTIFACT_IMPROVED: Off-by-one fixed (parse_range('1-5') → [1,2,3,4,5]); validation/error handling improved.
expectations.evidence: off-by-one fixed (range(start, end + 1)); RangeParseError added; docstring + type hints present.
